#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Read current version from version.json and bump the patch component.
patch=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('version.json'))['patch'])")
major=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('version.json'))['major'])")
minor=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('version.json'))['minor'])")

newpatch=$((patch + 1))

# Write back the updated version.json
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('version.json'));d['patch']=$newpatch;json.dump(d,open('version.json','w'))"

# Write the tag file
echo "v${major}.${minor}.${newpatch}" > tag.txt

</parameter>
</function>
